Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.conversation

Record Class Conversation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.conversation.Conversation
public record Conversation(ConversationId id, AgentId agentId, ConversationOwner owner, Title title, MessageCount messageCount, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime updatedAt) extends Record
Conversation aggregate (REQ-CHAT-002 / REQ-CHAT-009, design §4.1).

Carries identity, ownership, target agent, optional auto-derived title, the denormalized MessageCount, and the system-managed timestamps. Messages live in their own Message aggregate addressed by (conversationId, messageId) so the 64-message cap can be enforced atomically (via incrementMessageCount(OffsetDateTime)) without loading the full message list.

title MAY be null — it stays so from creation until the first non-empty user message is recorded, at which point EPIC-11's SendMessageService sets it via withTitle(Title, OffsetDateTime).

  • Method Details

    • withTitle

      public Conversation withTitle(Title newTitle, OffsetDateTime now)
      Returns a copy with the new Title and updatedAt bumped to now. Backs both:
      • the user-edit path on PATCH /conversations/{id} (REQ-CHAT-005 user-edit clause, US-10-008);
      • the first-user-message auto-derivation path inside SendMessageService (EPIC-11).

      Clearing the title back to null is NOT supported: the openapi UpdateConversationRequest.title is required, and the auto-derivation path always provides a non-null value.

    • incrementMessageCount

      public Conversation incrementMessageCount(OffsetDateTime now)
      Returns a copy with the message count incremented and updatedAt bumped to now. Throws ConversationFullException when the current count is already at 64 (REQ-CHAT-010).
